records.text: The Washington County Commission confirmed that Nate Brooksby resigned on Friday and retired after more than 30 years in law enforcement.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And the officials confirmed that he had tendered his resignation on Friday and that he announced his retirement, noting that he had served in law enforcement for more than 30 years.

verification.notes: The Washington County Sheriff's Office officially reported that Brooksby resigned on Friday, March 27, announced retirement, and had served more than 30 years in law enforcement.
